archetypes.name: artifact-taxonomy
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the plan's artifact-name taxonomy matches real producers and documented run-log/design-log contracts across scoped files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the plan's proposed filename patterns against the actual artifact producers and existing inclusion/exclusion functions in the scoped files. Look for dead patterns, missing real patterns, phased versus unphased naming drift, and contradictions between implementation comments, docs, and harness expectations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sidecar-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on first-match allow/deny ordering and whether proposed explicit dynamic Codex rules preserve sidecar exclusion boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the planned placement of new dynamic Codex allow clauses against the existing deny clauses for prompt, diag, done, event, dirty-tree, and related sidecars. Verify whether the plan covers every sidecar extension it claims without accidentally overriding earlier exclusions or relying on an ordering assumption that is false in the current code. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fixture-reality
archetypes.rationale: Reviews whether the planned harness updates use production-real fixture names and actually prove the intended contract boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the existing regression harnesses and the plan's fixture substitutions for evidence that each new assertion exercises a real producer shape rather than an invented filename. Check whether the proposed included and excluded fixtures cover both static and dynamic Codex/Cursor variants, phased and unphased cases, and the documented behavioral boundary. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
